<div class="card-body">
'''Dark Jedi Presence''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダーク・ジェダイ登場</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘の際に、ダーク・ジェダイが１名でもいる時に使用する。１フォース消費して、その他の帝国軍カードの戦闘力を全て２倍にする。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">暗黒卿の存在は、帝国軍の下級兵士の士気をいやがおうにも高める。「貴様が直々に指揮をとれ、少佐」。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dark Jedi Appears.

'''Card text:''' Use during a battle when at least one Dark Jedi is present. Use 1 Force to double the power of all other Imperial cards.

'''Lore:''' The presence of a Dark Lord raises the morale of Imperial rank-and-file soldiers, whether they like it or not. “You take command personally, Major.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese requires a Dark Jedi to be present, while the English specifies one of your Dark Jedi. The Japanese refers to other Imperial cards; the English refers to other Imperials there. The Japanese quotation uses the rank major, while the English uses commander.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dark Jedi Presence]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=93s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 1:33.</ref>
